entities.summary: Runde Environmental Centre is a research station at the Norwegian island of Runde. The centre has four main activities: a marine station, a house and hub for small spin-off businesses, an information centre, and a conference/overnight centre with 34 hotel-standard rooms in 8 apartment suites. The island of Runde is located in Herøy Municipality in Møre og Romsdal county, Norway. It is about 15 kilometres (9.3 mi) north of Fosnavåg.
